Title: How to Hide Virtual Game Cards on Nintendo Switch
IntroLines: Want to hide virtual game cards on your Nintendo Switch to clean up your library?
In this video, I'll show you how to easily hide them and how to bring them back whenever you want.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: HIDE A VIRTUAL GAME CARD
Steps: •  First, select " Virtual Game Cards " from your Nintendo Switch HOME Menu.
•  Choose the user profile linked to your Nintendo Account.
•  Scroll through your library and highlight the game card you want to conceal.
•  Press the " + " button on your controller to open " Options " .
•  Move down and select " Hide " .
•  Select " Hide " a second time to confirm.
•  Keep in mind that you can hide up to 300 virtual game cards per account.
•  Finally, check your list to confirm the virtual card is no longer visible.
Sections.Bridge: If you ever need to play or restore a card you've concealed, here's how to unhide it.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: VIEW AND UNHIDE HIDDEN GAME CARDS
Steps: •  First, open the " Virtual Game Cards " menu from your HOME Menu.
•  Select your user profile.
•  Scroll all the way down to the bottom of the card list.
•  Select " Hidden Software " .
•  Enter your account password or PIN if prompted for verification.
•  Highlight the game card you want to restore to your library.
•  Press the " + " button on your controller.
•  Select " Unhide " .
•  Finally, return to your main virtual cards list and verify that the game has reappeared.
Sections.Bridge: If the game was already downloaded, its icon might still appear on your HOME screen, so let's remove it.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 3: REMOVE DOWNLOADED ICONS FROM THE HOME MENU
Steps: •  First, return to your main Nintendo Switch HOME Menu.
•  Highlight the icon of the game you want to remove.
•  Press the " + " button on your Joy-Con or controller.
•  Move down and select " Manage Software " .
•  Select " Delete Software " .
•  Select " Delete " to confirm.
•  Don't worry, your game save data is stored separately and will not be lost.
•  Finally, check your HOME Menu to ensure the game is now completely hidden from your console.

OutroLines: And that's how you can easily hide and manage virtual game cards on your Nintendo Switch.
